correctness.rationale: Absolute convergence gives \(S_n=12x^2+16\varepsilon x^3+(144/5)x^4+(384/11)\varepsilon x^5+R_n\) and \(|R_n|<71x^6\) for \(x\le1/8\). Multiplying by the explicit \(A_n\) and using rational bounds yields \(0<A_nS_n-1<S_n/9\), hence \(A_n-1/9<S_n^{-1}<A_n\). The modulo-36 period and residues 20,32,8 prove floor equality. The first two indices use positive unit summands; the leading-coefficient ratio gives \(7/135\). The exact rational checker corroborated 64 indices but does not prove infinite validity.
